🟡 In Progress

Copy link to header
1. Future Weather Integration

Current forecasting uses historical weather successfully.
For future dates:
Current

Future weather missing → historical climatology

Target

Future weather forecast → use directly If unavailable → climatology fallback

Planned database table:
weather_forecast_daily
Expected fields:
  • LocationID
  • Date
  • TavgC
  • TminC
  • TmaxC
  • PrecipMM
  • WindMaxMS
  • SunHours
  • Provider
  • Model
  • ForecastRun
  • LoadedAt
Important rule:

Historical observed weather = model training Future forecast weather = future prediction Climatology = fallback

Future weather must not leak into historical backtesting.

3. Database Version Control

Moving toward:
database/migrations/
Each database change should have a SQL migration committed to Git.
Example:
005_weather_forecast.sql
This allows another machine to:

git pull run migrations get the same database structure

Longer term, consider Alembic.

Milestone Goal

The next major milestone is a customer-ready Blueberry Demand Planning Pilot where we can demonstrate not simply that PlanWise generates a forecast, but that it:

uses demand, price, promotions and external factors to produce forecasts, measures their accuracy, allows planners to create scenarios, identifies exceptions, and translates the results into management-level information.
